title: Installation & First-Time Configuration
description: Install Git across operating systems and configure identity, default branch names, line endings, and editors.

blocks.content: You are about to share a project. Future collaborators need to see who made each saved change. What is the smallest Git action that keeps the work safe?

Git records the name and email attached to new commits. Configure them once with `git config --global user.name "Your Name"` and `git config --global user.email "you@example.com"`.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["Working files"] -->|"choose an action"| B["Git history"] -->|"share or recover"| C["Team project"]
```

blocks.question: Why set your Git name and email?
options: So Git can encrypt every file
blocks.explanation: Git records this identity with commits so collaborators can see who made a change.

blocks.prompt: Model the Git idea in a tiny simulator. Export a function named `configureFile` that takes `(working, staged, file)` and returns a new staged list containing `file` once. Do not change either input list.

tests.description: works when no working files are listed yet
keeps an already staged file while adding another
